description: A local-only synthetic corpus for evaluating reproducibility and review-artifact clarity. It does not exercise agents, servers, credentials, models, networks, or live targets.
non_claim: Passing this corpus demonstrates only conformance on supplied synthetic declarations and pre-recorded metadata. It does not demonstrate runtime enforcement, input authenticity, attack prevention, or general security efficacy.

cases.title: Declared bundle generation
cases.rationale: A valid declared architecture produces a deterministic local bundle without executing a tool.
cases.non_claim: The bundle records supplied declarations; it does not prove a runtime architecture is complete or truthful.

cases.title: Missing trust label fails closed
cases.rationale: A missing trust label must stop local validation before an evidence bundle is created.
cases.non_claim: A schema error does not verify a real source or authenticate an input.

cases.title: Missing data classification fails closed
cases.rationale: A missing data classification must stop local validation before an evidence bundle is created.
cases.non_claim: A schema error does not classify real data or inspect message contents.

cases.title: Clear policy structure control
cases.rationale: A supplied default policy produces a clear deterministic policy-review control.
cases.non_claim: A clear static policy review does not authorize deployment or enforce runtime behavior.

cases.title: Approval-control review signal
cases.rationale: A supplied policy missing the expected approval control produces a review-required artifact.
cases.non_claim: A review signal is a human-review obligation, not an automatic block or enforcement decision.

cases.title: Identical bundle diff control
cases.rationale: Equivalent supplied bundles produce a no-signal control for declared bundle comparison.
cases.non_claim: No declared difference does not establish that a deployed system has not changed.

cases.title: Sensitive capability-growth diff
cases.rationale: A synthetic sensitive-tool capability addition becomes a deterministic review signal.
cases.non_claim: The signal describes a supplied declared delta; it does not prove exploitation or a vulnerability.

cases.title: Fail-open approval-control diff
cases.rationale: A supplied fail-closed to fail-open approval-control change remains review-visible without runtime execution.
cases.non_claim: The signal does not prove that a production approval control exists or is enforced.

cases.title: Clear minimized trace-review control
cases.rationale: Safe pre-recorded metadata maps to supplied declarations without including message content or tool arguments.
cases.non_claim: A clear metadata review does not authenticate or establish the completeness of a trace.

cases.title: Trace mapping and policy-drift review
cases.rationale: A supplied minimized trace with known mapping or policy drift produces a review-required artifact.
cases.non_claim: The artifact does not inspect a live agent, tool call, message, or external server.

cases.title: Clear local MCP metadata-profile control
cases.rationale: Supplied local MCP metadata can map clearly to supplied manifest declarations without transport access.
cases.non_claim: A clear profile review does not discover, connect to, or authenticate an MCP server.

cases.title: MCP authorization, mapping, and action-class drift review
cases.rationale: A supplied local profile with authorization, mapping, and action-class drift produces deterministic review findings.
cases.non_claim: The artifact does not validate OAuth, retrieve server metadata, or establish a live server’s actual capabilities.
